set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Docs use unregularized conditional-gradient or exact linear-OT subproblem terminology.
- Reported values identify included entropy/KL terms.
- *2 aliases and result fields agree on the documented objective.
- Solver decision tree is scientifically precise.
- Small-plan tests independently recompute every reported objective.
set.title: Correct exact-solver terminology and objective reporting
